comment: Pre-annotator cut AVB/ZVB clauses at Art. 36 / Art. 4 and labelled them BARE_ARTICLE; they are CONTRACT_ARTICLE (insurance AVB/ZVB) and include the sub-number .2/.6 and the abbreviation.
